description: This file defines classes and functions for creating, manipulating, and writing XML menu structures for desktop environments, specifically extending ElementTree for FD.o menu compliance. It includes classes XmlMenuElement and XmlMenuElementTree, and functions for converting menu models to XML, handling directories, and writing menu files.

classes.name: XmlMenuElement
classes.description: An extension of ElementTree.Element that adds menu construction methods.

classes.name: XmlMenuElementTree
classes.description: An extension of ElementTree.ElementTree that simplifies creating FD.o menus with headers and indentation.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Recursively indents XML elements for pretty printing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes XmlMenuElement with optional menu_name, adding a Name subelement if provided.

methods.name: addMenu
methods.description: Adds a <Menu> submenu element with optional filename and directory info.

methods.name: addMenuname
methods.description: Adds a <Menuname> element with specified name.

methods.name: addMergeFile
methods.description: Adds a <MergeFile> element with filename and merge type.

methods.name: addMerge
methods.description: Adds a <Merge> element with specified type.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Adds a <Category> element with specified category.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes XmlMenuElementTree with menu name and optional merge file, setting up root element.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the XML menu to a file with headers and indentation.

methods.name: model_to_xml_menus
methods.description: Recursively appends <Menu> elements from a model to a parent XML element.

methods.name: model_to_xml_includes
methods.description: Adds <Include> elements for application items lacking categories or in custom directories.

methods.name: model_to_xml_layout
methods.description: Adds <Layout> elements representing menu layout, including directories, applications, separators, and merges.

methods.name: model_children_to_xml
methods.description: Adds child menu items to a parent XML element from a model, handling menus, includes, and layouts.

methods.name: treeview_to_xml
methods.description: Exports current treeview model to an XML menu file, creating XmlMenuElementTree and writing to disk.
